query:
SELECT o.store, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(op.quantity) as total_units
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON o.id = op.orderId
WHERE (op.productName LIKE '%eufy%S1%Pro%' OR op.productName LIKE '%S1 Pro%')
  AND op.isGift = 'no'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
  AND (o.deliveryDate IS NULL OR o.deliveryDate > '2026-06-10 23:59:59')
  AND (o.store LIKE '%ANNIE%' OR o.store LIKE '%JOYCE%' OR o.store LIKE '%annie%' OR o.store LIKE '%joyce%')
GROUP BY o.store
ORDER BY o.store;
